title: 全球最大电动渡轮亮相 电池驱动航运新阶段
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: This is the world's largest electric ship, made of aluminum and powered by batteries.
segments.zh: 这是世界上最大的电动船，由铝制成，由电池驱动。

segments.en: The room we're in here is kind of the harbour of everything.
segments.zh: 我们所在的这个房间算是整个系统的核心。

segments.en: Lots and lots and lots of batteries.
Shipping is one of the hardest sectors to decarbonise.
segments.zh: 航运是最难脱碳的行业之一。

segments.en: Shipping is in the early days of electrification, but perhaps it's the ferry that seems uniquely primed to take batteries to open waters.
segments.zh: 航运业正处于电气化的早期阶段，但也许渡轮是唯一适合将电池推向开放水域的领域。

segments.en: Well, I retired 15 years ago, but that hasn't worked out well.
segments.zh: 嗯，我15年前退休了，但结果并不理想。

segments.en: This is Robert Clifford, a veteran shipbuilder who designs mostly passenger ferries.
segments.zh: 这是罗伯特·克利福德，一位资深造船师，主要设计客用渡轮。

segments.en: This goes back to when I was a fisherman in the 70s and then got into the ferry building in the 80s.
segments.zh: 这要追溯到70年代我还是渔夫的时候，然后80年代进入了渡轮建造行业。

segments.en: He's built a lot of ferries in his time.
segments.zh: 他一生中建造了许多渡轮。

segments.en: The first aluminium boat, a tank test model there.
segments.zh: 第一艘铝制船，那里的水箱测试模型。

segments.en: This is the Japanese version, business club Australia, chartered this boat.
segments.zh: 这是日本版，澳大利亚商业俱乐部包租了这艘船。
